THIS DIRECTION IS RECORDED SO THAT ANY LATER REPLACEMENT OF THE ESTIMAND CAN BE SEEN TO MOVE TOWARD ONE SIDE OR THE OTHER.

the_one_thing_P0_did_establish.what_it_certifies: that the patching harness moves what it claims to move
the_one_thing_P0_did_establish.what_it_does_not_certify: nothing about whether the model computes an intermediate, nothing about J, nothing about the paper, nothing about T
the_one_thing_P0_did_establish.why_it_survives: it is a property of the instrument, established by a construction whose expected value is fixed by token identity rather than by the estimand; the integrity failure is an additive baseline offset of about 0.0138, which cannot account for a recovery of 0.9862

implementation.what: the clean baseline was measured in a batch-of-one forward while every patched value was measured in a batch-of-48 forward
implementation.consequence: a constant additive offset of about 0.0138 in every restoration value
implementation.adjudicated: bug fix; the repair moves the implementation back toward the registered text
implementation.why_not: P-0 is closed; the repair belongs to the successor

registration.what: the estimand's behaviour under a purely disruptive patch, and the single global ceiling maximised across sites
registration.adjudicated: requires a new independent pre-registration, not an amendment to P-0
registration.why_not: changing a registered estimand after seeing the curve it produced would move the registered text toward the data, whatever the merits of the replacement

successor.relationship: a new independent pre-registration, not a continuation and not an amendment
successor.precedent: D-1, which registered a new question separately rather than reopening a closed one

claim_ceiling: A closure record for an uninterpretable phase. It licenses no claim of any kind, and the withheld verdict is not a conclusion.
